facts.claim: The FDA’s 510(k) database lists Precision Neuroscience’s Layer 7-T cortical interface as cleared on March 30, 2025, under the Neurology review panel.

Neuralink’s PRIME study remains listed as recruiting in ClinicalTrials.gov. It is a first-in-human early-feasibility study of the N1 brain implant and R1 surgical robot, with estimated enrollment of 15 participants.

A 2025 peer-reviewed study reported that an intracortical BCI decoded finger movements and enabled quadcopter-game control in an individual with paralysis; the work was conducted within the BrainGate2 clinical trial.
facts.source_title: Nature Medicine: A high-performance brain–computer interface for finger decoding and quadcopter game control

facts.claim: A 2026 Nature Medicine study reported independent at-home use of an intracortical BCI by a person with ALS for more than 3,800 hours over nearly two years, supporting speech and computer-cursor control.
facts.source_title: Nature Medicine: Long-term independent use of an intracortical brain–computer interface for speech and cursor control

facts.claim: In a published analysis of two participants in Synchron’s COMMAND trial, an endovascular Stentrode BCI recorded motor-related brain signals for three months and classified attempted movement versus rest with more than 90% accuracy for both participants.
facts.source_title: PubMed: Motor activity in gamma and high gamma bands recorded with a Stentrode from the human motor cortex in two people with ALS
